sections.Profile:
Hot Wheels City is under attack from the mad scientist Draven and his Creatures, and the player defends it by racing, building tracks and collecting cars, revving a tachometer toward Redline Mania and earning five Hero Cars to become a Hot Wheels Legend. American Pinball's 2020 licensed game based on Mattel's toy cars was designed by Joe Balcer with art by Jeff Busch, and its playfield carries five die-cast Hot Wheels cars, one of them spinning.
